description.fr-FR: Les catéchismes de l’évêque de Meaux pour son diocèse (1687) : le Premier et le Second Catéchisme (histoire sainte, symbole, commandements, sacrements, prière), les Instructions particulières sur la pénitence, l’eucharistie et la confirmation, et le Catéchisme des fêtes. Édition Lachat (1862).
description.en-US: The catechisms of the Bishop of Meaux for his diocese (1687): the First and Second Catechism (sacred history, the Creed, the commandments, the sacraments, prayer), the particular Instructions on penance, the Eucharist and confirmation, and the Catechism of the Feasts. Lachat edition (1862).
description.pt-BR: Os catecismos do bispo de Meaux para sua diocese (1687): o Primeiro e o Segundo Catecismo (história sagrada, símbolo, mandamentos, sacramentos, oração), as Instruções particulares sobre a penitência, a eucaristia e a confirmação, e o Catecismo das festas. Edição Lachat (1862).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume V, pages 001-007. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
